resultat: Matt Serra bat Georges St-Pierre par TKO (coups de poing) à 3:25 du 1er round.
resultat_en: Matt Serra defeats Georges St-Pierre by TKO (punches) at 3:25 of round 1.
contexte: Georges St-Pierre était favori à 7 contre 1 : la victoire de Matt Serra, qui lui prend la ceinture des mi-moyens, reste l'une des plus grandes surprises de l'histoire du MMA.
contexte_en: Georges St-Pierre was a 7-1 favorite: Matt Serra's win, which took his welterweight title, remains one of the biggest upsets in MMA history.
